OAT Images: Execute Planned Placement Run

oatImages.imagesRepoPath.description: Absolute path to the local images repo. Defaults to ~/dev/images.

oatImages.unsplashAccessKey.description: Unsplash API Access Key for thumbnail previews.

oatImages.ledgerApiUrl.description: Optional HTTP API base URL for writing image notebook records.

oatImages.claudeCliPath.description: Path or command name for the Claude Code CLI binary used by the pullquote-suggestion commands. Runs headless (`claude -p`) under your logged-in Claude Code session, so usage draws from your Claude subscription instead of separate Anthropic API billing.

oatImages.pullquoteModel.description: Claude model id passed to `claude -p --model` for pullquote candidate selection.

oatImages.pullquoteSopPath.description: Absolute path to sop-pullquote-selection.md, used verbatim as the system prompt. Defaults to ~/dev/oat-standards/sops/sop-pullquote-selection.md.

oatImages.pullquoteScanWindowChars.description: How many characters of document text (from the cursor forward) to send to Claude per Find Next Pullquote scan.

oatImages.chromePath.description: Path to a Chrome/Chromium executable, used headlessly (via puppeteer-core) to screenshot generated corridor maps for the Map tab. No browser is bundled with the extension — this must point at an existing install.

oatImages.mapBrightness.description: Brightness multiplier applied to corridor map screenshots after capture (1 = unchanged, <1 darker, >1 brighter). Left unset, no color grade runs at all.

oatImages.mapSaturation.description: Saturation multiplier applied to corridor map screenshots after capture (1 = unchanged, 0 = grayscale, >1 more saturated). Left unset, no color grade runs at all.

oatImages.mapContrast.description: Contrast slope applied to corridor map screenshots after capture, around the midtone (1 = unchanged, >1 punchier, <1 flatter). Left unset, no color grade runs at all.
